prompt: Create a two-level wooden bunk bed: four tall corner posts, a lower bed frame near the floor and an upper bed frame about 1.5 m higher, each holding a mattress, a ladder of five evenly spaced rungs fixed to one end of the upper frame, and a safety rail along each long side of the upper frame. Use natural wood for the frame and pale grey for the mattresses.

Create a garden hammock stand: two A-shaped leg pairs at the ends, one top beam across them, and a flat fabric bed hanging below the beam from four thin vertical rods attached to the beam right above its corners. Blue metal frame, white fabric.

Create a garden pergola: four square posts at the corners of a 3 m x 3 m stone patio, two main beams resting on top of the posts along one direction, and seven evenly spaced roof slats lying across the main beams in the other direction, overhanging slightly on both sides. Weathered wood, grey stone patio.

Create a park bench whose seat is made of five slats and whose backrest is made of three slats, held by two cast-iron side frames that include armrests, plus a round waste bin with a lid standing on the ground about half a metre to the right of the bench. Dark green iron, brown wooden slats and a black waste bin.

Create an entryway corner against one wall: a wall-mounted coat rack board with four evenly spaced hooks, a hat shelf mounted on the wall directly above the coat rack and the same width, and a low shoe bench standing on the floor directly below the coat rack, centred under it. Oak wood, black metal hooks.

Create a laundry corner: a front-loading washing machine on the floor with a dryer stacked exactly on top of it (same footprint, aligned edges), each with a round door window on the front face, and a wall shelf mounted just above the dryer holding two detergent bottles. White appliances, light wood shelf.

Create a small wooden footbridge crossing a stream: two stone banks on either side of a shallow blue water strip, a straight bridge deck made of planks resting on both banks, and a railing on each side of the deck with posts at both ends and in the middle connected by a handrail along the full length. Wood bridge, grey stone, blue water.

Create a living-room TV wall: a low TV console standing against the wall, a flat TV on a small stand centred on top of the console, and two wall shelves mounted above the TV, one on each side, at the same height and symmetric about the TV's centre. Walnut furniture, black TV.
